id: 04_VTU Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory Familiarization of Switches and Rheostats G
title: 变阻器与开关
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/04_VTU Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory Familiarization of Switches and Rheostats G.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/04_VTU Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory Familiarization of Switches and Rheostats G/src.py

points.K4: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
points.K9: 任取两端：一固定一滑动
points.S1: 变阻器：先放最大，不超额定
points.S2: 变阻器会发烫，电阻丝带电
points.S5: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有一根长长的滑线变阻器和几个开关，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a long tubular sliding rheostat and several switches, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识变阻器和各种开关。

shots.scene: 变阻器、船形开关、闸刀开关三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a tubular sliding rheostat, a rocker switch and a knife-blade changeover switch. No people.
shots.narration: 一个调电阻，一个管通断。

shots.scene: 阿杰把变阻器滑块推到一端，就要合闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes the rheostat slider all the way to one end and reaches for the power switch.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手推了推滑块，就想合闸。

shots.scene: 电流表指针猛地打满、变阻器冒热气的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ammeter needle slamming past full scale and a rheostat with heat waves, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 滑块放错了位置，电流一下冲得很大。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指着滑块位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at the slider position.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先看滑块在哪儿。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 变阻器和开关，用对了才安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着变阻器和一排开关
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a rheostat and a row of different switches.
shots.narration: 做实验前，先把它们认清楚。

shots.scene: 电阻符号上加一个斜箭头
shots.prompt_en: A resistor symbol with a diagonal arrow across it. No people.
shots.narration: 变阻器，就是阻值可以调的电阻。

shots.scene: 变阻器特写：瓷管上密绕电阻丝，上方有滑块
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a tubular rheostat: resistance wire tightly wound on a ceramic tube, with a slider on a bar above it. No people.
shots.narration: 瓷管上绕着电阻丝，上面有个滑块。

shots.scene: 两端和滑块处三个接线柱被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The two end terminals and the slider terminal of the rheostat highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 两头是固定端，滑块是滑动端。

shots.section_title: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
shots.scene: 变阻器侧面的空白铭牌，旁边是电阻和电流图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank nameplate on the side of a rheostat, with a resistance icon and a current icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 铭牌上标着阻值和额定电流。
overlay: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流

shots.section_title: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着电流图标的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a current arrow icon.
shots.narration: 额定电流和阻值一样重要。

shots.scene: 长段电阻丝和短段电阻丝对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a long section of resistance wire with a big resistance bar, a short section with a small bar. No people.
shots.narration: 接入的电阻丝越长，电阻越大。

shots.scene: 滑块位置使整根电阻丝都接入，电流箭头走完全程
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon with the slider positioned so that current arrows travel the entire length of the wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻丝全长接入，电阻最大。

shots.scene: 滑块位置使电流只走一小段
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon with the slider positioned so that current arrows travel only a short section of wire. No people.
shots.narration: 只接入一小段，电阻最小。

shots.scene: 老周指着三电压表电路图里的变阻器
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the rheostat in a three-voltmeter circuit diagram on a board.
shots.narration: 后面三电压表法实验，要用到它。

shots.scene: 两种变阻器符号并排
shots.prompt_en: Two rheostat circuit symbols side by side: a zigzag resistor with a diagonal arrow, and a box resistor with a sliding arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 画电路图时，用这两种符号。

shots.scene: 符号一端标固定，箭头端标可变
shots.prompt_en: One rheostat symbol with one end marked by a fixed pin icon and the arrow marked by a slider icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一端固定，箭头那端可变。

shots.section_title: 任取两端：一固定一滑动
shots.scene: 小研把导线接到一个固定端和滑动端（电源已断开）
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student connects leads to one fixed terminal and the slider terminal of a rheostat on a switched-off bench.
shots.narration: 任选一个固定端和滑动端接入。
overlay: 任取两端：一固定一滑动

shots.section_title: 任取两端：一固定一滑动
shots.scene: 滑块左右移动，电阻条变长变短
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the slider moving left and right with a resistance bar growing and shrinking. No people.
shots.narration: 滑块位置决定电阻的大小。

shots.scene: 楼梯两头的开关控制同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a switch at the bottom and top controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 双控、多地控制照明，都要用到开关。

shots.scene: 一个开关图标，标出“极”和“掷”
shots.prompt_en: A switch symbol with its moving blade and its contact points highlighted in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 开关看两样：几个极，几个掷。

shots.scene: 单极单掷开关符号和一个船形开关
shots.prompt_en: A single pole single throw switch symbol next to a black rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 单极单掷：一个极，一个位置。

shots.scene: 电池、开关、灯泡电路：开关断开灯灭，闭合灯亮
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit icons: battery, open switch and dark bulb; battery, closed switch and lit bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 断开就断电，闭合就接通。

shots.scene: 单极双掷开关符号：一个刀片可拨到两个位置
shots.prompt_en: A single pole double throw switch symbol: one blade that can swing to position one or position two. No people.
shots.narration: 单极双掷：一个极，两个位置。

shots.scene: 刀片先接位置一，再接位置二
shots.prompt_en: The blade connected to position one, then switching over to position two. No people.
shots.narration: 同一时刻只接一个位置。

shots.scene: 两只单极双掷开关控制楼梯灯
shots.prompt_en: Two single pole double throw switches at both ends of a staircase controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 双控照明，就靠它。

shots.scene: 双极单掷开关符号：两个刀片用虚线连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A double pole single throw switch symbol: two blades linked by a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 双极单掷：两个极一起动作。

shots.scene: 一只开关同时接通两路电路
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one double pole switch connecting two separate circuits to their loads at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 一扳，两路电路同时接通。

shots.scene: 双极双掷开关符号和一个方形开关
shots.prompt_en: A double pole double throw switch symbol next to a square rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 双极双掷：两个极，两个位置。

shots.scene: 触点示意：常开和常闭
shots.prompt_en: A contact diagram icon showing a normally open pair and a normally closed pair. No people.
shots.narration: 触点分常开和常闭，用在复杂电路。

shots.scene: 四种开关符号排成两行两列
shots.prompt_en: Four switch symbols arranged in a two by two grid: single pole single throw, single pole double throw, double pole single throw, double pole double throw. No people.
shots.narration: 单极还是双极，单掷还是双掷？

shots.scene: 阿杰对着图数手指，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student counts on his fingers in front of the grid; the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 数一数极和掷，就分清了。

shots.scene: 三极单掷开关符号：三个刀片连动
shots.prompt_en: A triple pole single throw switch symbol: three blades linked by a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 三极单掷：三个极一起动作。

shots.scene: 三相电源三根线经开关接到负载
shots.prompt_en: An icon of three supply lines passing through a three-pole switch to a three-phase load. No people.
shots.narration: 三相电源和负载，同时接通、同时断开。

shots.scene: 实验室的三相转换开关板：三个刀闸、两排接线柱
shots.prompt_en: A lab panel with a three-pole changeover knife switch and two rows of terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 三极双掷：三相电路切换到两个位置。

shots.scene: 电机图标和电网图标之间一个转换开关
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator and a power grid with a changeover switch between them. No people.
shots.narration: 电机实验里，用它做三相切换。

shots.scene: 王老师站在电机实验台旁示意学生后退
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands beside a motor test bench and signals students to stay back.
shots.narration: 这类实验，必须在老师指导下做。

shots.scene: 变阻器和六种开关图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon and six switch symbols light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 变阻器和开关，是电工实验的基础。

shots.section_title: 变阻器：先放最大，不超额定
shots.scene: 滑块推到电阻最大的一端，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon with the slider at the maximum resistance end and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 作限流用，通电前先放到电阻最大。
overlay: 变阻器：先放最大，不超额定

shots.section_title: 变阻器：先放最大，不超额定
shots.scene: 小研看着电流表慢慢移动滑块
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches an ammeter while slowly moving the rheostat slider.
shots.narration: 通电后看着电流表，慢慢调。

shots.section_title: 变阻器：先放最大，不超额定
shots.scene: 电流指针越过额定红线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a current needle passing a red rated-current line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电流不能超过铭牌额定值。

shots.section_title: 变阻器会发烫，电阻丝带电
shots.scene: 变阻器上方冒出热浪
shots.prompt_en: Heat waves rising from a tubular rheostat on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 电流大时，变阻器会发烫。
overlay: 变阻器会发烫，电阻丝带电

shots.section_title: 变阻器会发烫，电阻丝带电
shots.scene: 通电时手摸电阻丝的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand touching the bare resistance wire of a powered rheostat, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻丝是裸露的，通电时不能碰。

shots.section_title: 变阻器会发烫，电阻丝带电
shots.scene: 变阻器旁的纸张和布被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Paper sheets and a cloth lying next to a rheostat, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边别放纸张等易燃物。

shots.section_title: 变阻器会发烫，电阻丝带电
shots.scene: 断电后，老李用绝缘柄调滑块
shots.prompt_en: With the power off, the facility engineer moves the rheostat slider by its insulated handle.
shots.narration: 调滑块，只握绝缘手柄。

shots.scene: 开关串在相线上，打绿勾；串在零线上，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit icons: a switch in the line conductor with a green check, and a switch in the neutral conductor crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 单极开关，要接在相线上。

shots.scene: 开关断开后，灯座不再带电
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open switch in the line conductor and a lamp holder with no lightning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 这样断开后，灯和负载才不带电。

shots.scene: 三相电路三根线同时断开的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a three-pole switch opening all three lines at once. No people.
shots.narration: 三相电路，用三极开关同时断开。

shots.scene: 开关断开，但上游线路仍有闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open switch, with the wire upstream of the switch still marked by a lightning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 开关断开，前面的线照样有电。

shots.scene: 敞开式闸刀开关的接线柱被高亮，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An open knife switch with its terminals highlighted and a yellow electrical warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 敞开的闸刀和接线柱，不能用手碰。

shots.scene: 老李拉下总闸，挂上空白的禁止合闸牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls down the main switch and hangs a blank do-not-switch-on tag on it.
shots.narration: 检修要断上级电源、挂牌，由电工处理。

shots.scene: 开关铭牌与电路额定值对比打勾
shots.prompt_en: A switch nameplate icon and a circuit rating icon with matching marks and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 开关的额定电压电流，要和电路相配。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰拉下实验台开关后再接线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power before connecting the rheostat and switches.
shots.narration: 接线、改线、拆线，一律先断电。
overlay: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师检查滑块位置和接线
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the slider position and the wiring against a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 请老师查接线，也查滑块位置。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师点头，阿杰才合闸
shots.prompt_en: After the safety administrator nods, the young male student switches the bench power on.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能合闸通电。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 通电时伸手改线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand moving a wire on a powered board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不带电改线，有问题先断电。

shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研冲去拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside the bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student rushes to pull the main switch.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先切断电源，不徒手拉人。

shots.scene: 老周打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.scene: 变阻器旁起小火，老李拉闸后用二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A small fire beside a rheostat; the facility engineer switches off the power and uses a carbon dioxide extinguisher.
shots.narration: 电气起火，先断电，不用水浇。

shots.scene: 火势变大，众人撤离，保卫处值班员打电话
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; everyone leaves under an exit sign while the security officer calls on a phone.
shots.narration: 控制不住就撤离，拨打 119。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 变阻器滑块在两端的两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two rheostat icons: slider at the maximum end and slider at the minimum end. No people.
shots.narration: 切入最大，切出最小，看铭牌额定值。

shots.scene: 六种开关符号排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Six switch symbols in a row, from single pole single throw to triple pole double throw. No people.
shots.narration: 数极数掷，认清六种开关。

shots.scene: 限流最大、开关断相线、挂牌三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a slider at maximum, a switch in the line conductor, and a lockout tag. No people.
shots.narration: 先放最大，开关断相线，断开也要防电。

shots.scene: 断电开关、老师检查、灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a switched-off power switch, a teacher checking a circuit, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 断电接线，查过再通电，异常先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的实验台前挥手道别，开关都在断开位置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy bench where all switches are in the off position.
shots.narration: 调得稳，断得清，下次见！
